scope: Observed build-8 input-tab restoration defect and applied parent-draft binding correction. Source-fidelity evidence only for the correction; actual build-9 navigation acceptance was pending at this source curation.

sequence: Select Description and enter an unfamiliar synthetic meal description.
Build local review reaches the unknown/no-reliable-range state.
Open checked-amount form, enter synthetic item/37, then Cancel; no amount is committed.
Back to Add a meal returns with Photo selected while retained description still enables Build.
baselineObservation.basis: Root CUA actions and returned AX/pixels summarized in the operator record. Not an automated replay.

screenshot.scope: Back-transition pixels show Photo selected and an enabled Build action; transition edges are clipped. This is not a layout or full-journey pass. The screenshot alone does not establish all preceding actions or show the retained hidden description.

baselineObservation.dataLimit: Presentation-state reset rather than demonstrated draft-text loss. The canceled form created no checked amount in this observed sequence. No meal-photo AI or real meal nutrition was evaluated.

sourceCause.entryState: showsPhotoInput was child-local @State, while mealDescription remained parent-owned.
sourceCause.appearanceAssignment: AddMealView.task always assigned showsPhotoInput = !startsWithDescription before checking initialPhotoSource.
sourceCause.initialPreference: Home Start used the default initial preference for Photo; tapping Description did not change that parent initial preference.
sourceCause.navigationBoundary: Returning from Estimate leaves the addMeal route in the path. Existing clearMealDraft runs when the meal-flow path becomes empty, so description text is retained.
sourceCause.eligibility: canBuildLocalReview accepts nonempty description or a food photo independently of the visible tab; its behavior was not changed.

changes: Move showsPhotoInput into ContentView meal-draft @State and pass a binding into AddMealView.
Set the initial mode only when beginning a draft; clear-draft resets Photo.
Parent Practice selection explicitly sets Description before existing immediate estimate navigation.
Remove the AddMealView appearance-time mode assignment.
